name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Far Seer Mok'thardin gathers the jungle's power for the Horde. His earlier rites have succeeded, and he seeks sharp claws and a pristine feline fang for an enchantment.

sections.title: Harnessing the Jungle
sections.body: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Far Seer Mok'thardin studies the wild's feral power. He seeks to bend it for the Horde. His first rites have succeeded, and he offers to shape an enchanted relic. Those willing must enter the thick underbrush and hunt the deadly predators nearby.

sections.title: The Stalkers of Mizjah
sections.body: Mok'thardin's rite calls for eight claws from shadowmaw panthers and a pristine fang from a tigress. The fierce cats roam across Stranglethorn Vale. Many prowl southeast of the Mizjah Ruins, just beyond the river.

faq.q: Who is requesting these beast parts?
faq.answer: Far Seer Mok'thardin, an orc shaman at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale, asks for the ingredients for his rites.

faq.q: Where can the panthers and tigresses be found?
faq.answer: The panthers and tigresses roam the dense jungle. Mok'thardin points hunters southeast of the Mizjah Ruins, just across the river.

faq.q: Why does Far Seer Mok'thardin need these items?
faq.answer: Mok'thardin seeks to harness the jungle's natural magic, cast powerful enchantments, and craft a special item for Horde champions.

faq.q: What comes next in Mok'thardin's ritual work?
faq.answer: Once Mok'thardin has the claws and fang, he continues his ritual crafting in the next stage of the enchantment series.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know Far Seer Mok'thardin seeks to harness the jungle's magic for your people.
